summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of TEA-76/77/78 RPG Adventure shell (/adventure/* routes replacing /hub). Ran full E2E flow on desktop (1440x900) + mobile (390x844) spot-check. 49/49 critical UI assertions passed.

issues: Meadowfall Grove island/label is positioned at left:10% which on narrow mobile widths causes the name chip to be clipped at the left edge of the painted canvas (visible as 'eadowfall Grove'). The realm-1 island circle itself also overlaps the left border. Consider raising left% from 10% to ~16% or constraining label width on small viewports.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Tune RealmMap LIVE_POSITIONS / label width for <420px viewports so the Meadowfall Grove chip isn't clipped at the left edge.

(Optional) Admin & Parent 'Open game' link href targeting /adventure was inspected via code (AdminDashboard.tsx / Parent.tsx in files_of_reference). Playwright assertion was inconclusive because Admin requires PIN entry; recommend adding data-testid='admin-open-game' and 'parent-open-game' to make these links directly assertable.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean: /hub route correctly uses <Navigate to='/adventure' replace/>; all required data-testids present and wired (adv-start-btn, adv-active-companion, adv-quick-*, adventure-dock, realm-world-canvas, realm-node-realm-1, realm-locked-realm-2, realm-legend-realm-1, town-pin-grid, town-tile-*, companions-active, companions-card-*, companions-pick-*, companions-go-battle, quest-card-q-1, quest-start-q-1, dock-*).
TownHub correctly redirects unknown realmId via <Navigate to='/adventure/realms' replace/>.
Shop tile gracefully renders as focusable non-link <div tabIndex={0}> when cfg.to is missing.

AdventureLayout dock uses fixed bottom positioning with sufficient pb-28 padding on main; verified on mobile no overlap with primary CTAs on /adventure (Start Adventure button sits well above the dock).
React-Router future-flag warnings appear in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — informational only, no errors.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 2580 not exercised in this iteration; onboarding used name='Tester', Grade=Kindergarten (default), Companion=Spriggle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation invocation starts a fresh session (no persisted localStorage between calls) — when testing /adventure/* deep links, complete the onboarding flow first (Landing→Play→Continue grade→fill name 'Tester'→Continue→Spriggle→Start Adventure) in the SAME script before navigating to /adventure/*. RequirePlayer + requireStarter guards will otherwise bounce you to /onboarding. The grade picker defaults to Kindergarten selected; just press Continue. The character name input must be filled (use get_by_placeholder(/Mochi/)) before Continue is enabled.
